name: Campaign narrative linked to extremist content or designated groups
description: Fundraising page, post or channel references violent groups, glorifies violence or is linked to accounts removed for extremism.
fp: Political or religious speech, and news reporting, may reference the same topics lawfully.

sources.text: FATF, Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment Guidance (2019)
